notes: Generic teaching yard only; roof, BIM/IFC, weather, and arbitrary site geometry are not implemented.
Adaptive targeting uses local practice counts, not a learned RL/GAN policy.

hazards.action: Stop exposure to the edge and have appropriate fall protection provided before work resumes.
hazards.description: A worker stands on an 8 ft elevated construction platform with an open edge and no fall protection.
hazards.observation: Elevated platform: 8 ft above the lower level. One edge is open. No net or personal fall arrest system is provided.

hazards.action: Keep workers clear and have qualified personnel establish appropriate electrical protection before work proceeds.
hazards.description: An open energized panel has accessible live parts within a worker's reach.
hazards.observation: Panel door open; circuit energized; exposed terminals within reach of the work position. No effective insulating guard.

hazards.action: Stop entry and have a competent person arrange an appropriate protective system before workers enter.
hazards.description: A worker occupies a 6 ft deep trench in soil with no protective system.
hazards.observation: Trench depth: 6 ft; material is soil, not stable rock. A worker is inside. No shoring, shielding, or protective slope.

hazards.action: Remove the worker from exposure, secure the materials, and provide appropriate head protection.
hazards.description: A worker without a protective helmet is beneath elevated loose construction materials.
hazards.observation: Loose materials are stored overhead; a worker below wears no protective helmet.

limitations: Teaching-rule checks only; not regulatory certification.
Reachability is a 2D approximation, not a physics or structural-support simulation.
Catalog scenarios and teaching effectiveness still require independent expert review.
